changes: Exact conditional BB root jam targets; once-per-generation full-population BTN initial response regrets; widened float64 inference with stored/fitted float32 weights. stopping: Fixed update count or resource/deadline/activity stop; no outcome-dependent stopping, retry, checkpoint selection or partial quality claim.
